body:
Private training now has confirmed lifecycle actions, immutable program history, explicit actual units, recoverable guided setup/memory and dated local Coach decisions. SQLite ownership and stale-result guards protect recovery. Core training stays guest-only, local and deterministic, with the qualified public-content gate preserved.

Coach date editing and optional local voice correction have explicit guidance and measured keyboard scroll space. Voice refusal is honest when the offline model is missing; typed values require explicit review before entering an unsaved draft. Persistent captions now identify populated Reps, Duration(seconds), Distance(meters), RPE and RIR fields, including zero values. Backgrounding clears unconfirmed voice previews.

Validation:

- Exact app/test source **86a26c4490ab091f865e20773151a0443a9f2b8c** passes full `npm run verify`: **1,220 tests/144 suites**, Doctor21/21, security11, audit0, asset/vendor/config checks and both mobile JavaScript exports. Independently reviewed test-only timing/cleanup changes retain all original value assertions. Two earlier five-second timeout runs remain documented failures.
- Standalone guest Android x86_64 build and update installation pass on CAM-DESKTOP's hardware-accelerated Pixel7-profile emulator, Android16/API36. APK SHA256 **a13dd04bae2cae236fd9eb8f2c6e2e49da9b26c7d85aefa84e47e85d222d9a1e**. Normal/200% closed-keyboard screenshots show wrapping captions and restored26seconds/RPE7.
- At200% text, the typed voice editor reads back26 seconds,RPE seven exactly after dismissing an observed Gboard stylus tutorial. The floating/stylus keyboard case is scoped; it is not a docked-keyboard or speech-recognition pass. The initial intercepted typing and scroll/chooser interruptions remain explicit. No Review/Apply/Complete used in these latest checks.
- External QA receiver opened schema17 JSON at14:40:49.874Z: **1,082records/36arrays**, all actual/draft payloads unchanged, only draft autosave timestamps refreshed. Font1.0 and TalkBack Off restored.
- Earlier ae-source read-only observer proves TalkBack and UiAutomation coexisted during injected Home/Resume navigation. It does not prove spoken traversal or participant usability. Ordinary UIAutomator suppresses services; its focus checks are not TalkBack acceptance.
- Earlier binary-specific evidence covers Coach receipt recovery, handover, deletion/restore, notifications refusal and date/voice keyboard cases. Their scope stays dated in the reports.
- Remote native38557410901 and quality38557410922 succeeded at **f5f3e9c4**, covering ae app source: Android arm64/x86_64 build proof and unsigned iOS simulator compile/bind/install/cold launch. Latest-head CI is pending; none of these establish current full iOS journeys.

[Latest native QA and launch instructions](https://github.com/camster91/Shift6/blob/0b997f90ff43370a655830eb72c3494a665d0a7f/docs/52_NATIVE_ACCESSIBILITY_AND_LABELS_QA.md) | [Coach QA](https://github.com/camster91/Shift6/blob/0b997f90ff43370a655830eb72c3494a665d0a7f/docs/50_LOCAL_COACH_REVIEW_QA.md) | [Voice QA](https://github.com/camster91/Shift6/blob/0b997f90ff43370a655830eb72c3494a665d0a7f/docs/51_LOCAL_VOICE_NATIVE_QA.md) | [Reconciled TODO](https://github.com/camster91/Shift6/blob/0b997f90ff43370a655830eb72c3494a665d0a7f/docs/43_SHIPPING_GOAL_AND_TODO.md)

All **55 open issues** are mapped once and remain open pending their individual acceptance criteria. Provisional engineering score stays **53/100**; doc34 human acceptance is unverified. Physical S25Ultra/iPhone, spoken assistive-technology traversal, six-week participant pilot, successful recognition, complete repeat-week integration, qualified public content, release signing/support and store acceptance remain outstanding. Future repetition/original-finish storage is isolated and inactive; its tests/schema are not shipping-app evidence. Disabled Gemini preparation remains separate PR350. This draft is stacked on #349. No merge, deployment, paid activation, store submission or issue closure.
